arm_c.blocked_by: LibreLane exposes no fence, region or cell-group constraint. There is no supported way to tell this flow that sixteen groups of standard cells must each stay inside a rectangle.
arm_c.what_an_unconstrained_arm_c_would_be: sixteen rings handed to the same unconstrained placer that produced Arm A, which is Arm A's treatment under a second name

mechanism.cost: PLACED is not FIRM, so detailed placement may move a cell and only reports the displacement afterwards. chip/placement_fidelity.py reads the DEF the build writes and says whether any did
mechanism.why: the only mechanism left. FIRM at step 17 stops OpenROAD cutting the cell's row (ODB-0386), and Arm A shares 37 rows with the Arm B macro block; runs 72, 73 and 74

retired.why_chosen: the only mechanism in this flow that fixes a cell so detailed placement cannot move it
retired.why_retired: odb::cutRows at OpenROAD dcf3613 leaves any row holding a fixed standard cell uncut, so the rows through the macro block ran whole and the endcaps landed inside u_rob4, u_rob8 and u_rob12
